author: Kushal
problem: A 100 km course has water stations every 5 km, including the start and the goal. Read N (0 to 100), the runner's position in km, and print the position of the nearest station.
bug_description: Loops over range(20) instead of range(21), so the station at the 100 km goal is never considered.

comments.accurate: Prints the position of the water station closest to N
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the position of the closest water station from 0 to 95 km
comments.wrong_location: Station range verified; check that list.index picks the nearer station on ties
